usage: This idiom describes achieving excellent results with relatively little effort.
It is often used to praise efficient methods or strategies that save time and energy.
The phrase literally translates to 'half the effort, double the result,' emphasizing productivity.
It is commonly applied in work, study, and daily life when efficiency is improved.
Use this idiom to encourage finding smarter ways to accomplish tasks rather than working harder.

examples.sentence: 用左新嘅軟件之後，工作效率提升，真係事半功倍。
examples.jyutping: jung6 zo2 san1 ge3 jyun5 gin6 zi1 hau6, gung1 zok3 haau6 leot6 tai2 sing1, zan1 hai6 si6 bun3 gung1 pui5.
examples.meaning: After using the new software, work efficiency improved; it really was double result with half effort.

examples.sentence: 學習時用啱方法，成績可以事半功倍。
examples.jyutping: hok6 zaap6 si4 jung6 ngaam1 fong1 faat3, sing4 zek3 ho2 ji5 si6 bun3 gung1 pui5.
examples.meaning: When studying with the right methods, results can be achieved with half the effort.

examples.sentence: 團隊合作得好，效率自然事半功倍。
examples.jyutping: tyun4 deoi2 hap6 zok3 dak1 hou2, haau6 leot6 zi6 jin4 si6 bun3 gung1 pui5.
examples.meaning: When the team works well together, efficiency naturally becomes double result with half effort.

examples.sentence: 佢搵到啱嘅策略，做嘢真係事半功倍。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 wan2 dou3 ngaam1 ge3 caak3 leuk6, zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 si6 bun3 gung1 pui5.
examples.meaning: He found the right strategy, and working became truly double result with half effort.
